"Not long ago I lived in an apartment where the DEA and the State police both operated crack houses"

From A Reader:

I read you article on how the narcs created crack.

I tip my hat to you for standing up for the truth.

Not long ago I lived in an apartment where the DEA and the State police both operated crack houses. They served crack to their entrapment teams, stool pigeons, and set up crews 24 hours a day. In one apartment the dealers worked 8-hour shifts.

The other apartment had a two man team living there full time. What they would do is bring newcomers to visit the crack houses with them, then when ever the new sucker came back on his own he would be caught in possession within a few blocks of the place.

These guys tried to set me up by planting the stash in my place, but I advised the local sheriff of the scheme and left before they could entrap me. Within days the place cleared out, and all of the drug dealers disappeared. I believe this method is widespread, and keeps the narcs very busy.

Keep up the good fight.

(Marijuananews note: When I wrote How The Narcs Created Crack I was really just analyzing the economics of contraband. The relative bulkiness of marijuana and its aromatic nature make it much harder to smuggle than white powders. Of course, the highly addictive nature of the powders also generates high levels of repeat business, as with the legal drugs, alcohol and tobacco.
See

However, over the last ten years we have also had glimpses of other forces at work. Most obvious was the CIA’s long standing connection with smugglers.
See
Chicago Tribune Article Supports CIA/Crack Connection -- Favorable Comments On "Dark Alliance"

Perhaps the most vicious and yet invisible aspect of how marijuana prohibition really works involves the use of police-protected cocaine and heroin dealers. These people are truly above the law. Unlike even the undercover police with whom they work, there is no record of their existence. For obvious reasons.

Disturbingly, I have heard numerous stories similar to the one above about police involvement in the cocaine trade at the local level. While I was at NORML I encountered two cases involving women who were medical marijuana users with serious conditions, who were set-up by snitches who were being supplied cocaine by the police. The patients were crushed mercilessly.

They provide the police with payoffs and information on their competitors. If the police are also true believers in the prohibitionist ideology that emphasizes the suppression of marijuana at all costs, and many are, then the end justifies the means. Hence, it is appropriate to use a crack addict/snitch to entrap medical marijuana users, the people who are most dangerous to the state ideology.

This practice also explains the fanatical support for marijuana prohibition amongst the lumpen-narks, the thugs who run the actual day-to-day operations of the police state.

In rural areas, geographically most of the country, this is the sheriff’s department, the major local political force, as well. They back people like Bob Barr and Asa Hutchinson.
See
The Appalling Idiots Who Govern Us
From Politically Incorrect
and
Editorial Page Editor of the Atlanta Constitution. Says "Barr is the Democrat’s best ally."

So great is the corruption of our "criminal justice system" that I really do not think that there is much that can be done about these practices, short of ending marijuana prohibition, and also taking the profit out of addiction to hard drugs.
See
How Marijuana Prohibition Corrupts All Of Our Institutions
– Medicine, Law Enforcement, Journalism
And How That Corruption Sustains Prohibitionism

When the DEAland elites wake up to the dangers of this practice – and obviously they will not learn about it from the establishment media -- then there will be a power struggle that will split the local and national elites.

At that point, the role of the Internet will be paramount. Stay tuned.

In the meantime, if other readers have had similar experiences, I would like to hear from you.
